#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Build the kvhttp release binary at ./app.
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
clang -arch arm64 -O2 -Wl,-dead_strip -o app src/main.s src/http.s src/store.s

// http.s — per-connection HTTP/1.1 request handling for kvhttp.
//
// conn_main(fd) runs on its own detached thread: it reads one request,
// dispatches it to the store, writes one response and closes the socket.

        .equ    HBUF_SIZE, 65536        // max request line + headers
        .equ    MAX_BODY, 1048576       // 1 MiB value limit
        .equ    DRAIN_MAX, 0x4000000    // discard at most 64 MiB after an early error
        .equ    RESP_BUF, 4096
        .equ    INLINE_MAX, 3584        // bodies up to this size share the header write

        .equ    SOL_SOCKET, 0xffff
        .equ    SO_SNDTIMEO, 0x1005
        .equ    SO_RCVTIMEO, 0x1006
        .equ    IPPROTO_TCP, 6
        .equ    TCP_NODELAY, 1
        .equ    SHUT_WR, 1
        .equ    EINTR, 4

        .equ    KV_PATH_LEN, 3          // "/kv"
        .equ    KV_PREFIX_LEN, 4        // "/kv/"

        .equ    M_OTHER, 0
        .equ    M_GET, 1
        .equ    M_PUT, 2
        .equ    M_DELETE, 3

        // Indices into L_status_tab
        .equ    ST_200, 0
        .equ    ST_201, 1
        .equ    ST_204, 2
        .equ    ST_400, 3
        .equ    ST_404, 4
        .equ    ST_405, 5
        .equ    ST_413, 6
        .equ    ST_431, 7
        .equ    ST_500, 8

.macro  LOADADDR reg, sym
        adrp    \reg, \sym@PAGE
        add     \reg, \reg, \sym@PAGEOFF
.endm

        .section __TEXT,__text,regular,pure_instructions

// void *conn_main(void *fd)
//
// Register plan:
//   x19 fd            x20 header buffer   x21 bytes buffered / body bytes read
//   x22 header end    x23 body buffer     x24 Content-Length
//   x25 method code   x26 path / key ptr  x27 path / key len
//   x28 nonzero => drain unread input before closing
//   [sp,#96], [sp,#104]: out-params for store_get / store_list
        .globl  _conn_main
        .p2align 2
_conn_main:
        stp     x29, x30, [sp, #-112]!
        mov     x29, sp
        stp     x19, x20, [sp, #16]
        stp     x21, x22, [sp, #32]
        stp     x23, x24, [sp, #48]
        stp     x25, x26, [sp, #64]
        stp     x27, x28, [sp, #80]
        mov     x19, x0
        mov     x20, #0
        mov     x23, #0
        mov     x28, #0

        mov     w0, w19
        mov     w1, #SOL_SOCKET
        mov     w2, #SO_RCVTIMEO
        LOADADDR x3, L_io_timeout
        mov     w4, #16
        bl      _setsockopt
        mov     w0, w19
        mov     w1, #SOL_SOCKET
        mov     w2, #SO_SNDTIMEO
        LOADADDR x3, L_io_timeout
        mov     w4, #16
        bl      _setsockopt
        mov     w8, #1
        str     w8, [sp, #104]
        mov     w0, w19
        mov     w1, #IPPROTO_TCP
        mov     w2, #TCP_NODELAY
        add     x3, sp, #104
        mov     w4, #4
        bl      _setsockopt

        mov     x0, #HBUF_SIZE
        bl      _malloc
        cbz     x0, Lc_close
        mov     x20, x0
        mov     x21, #0

        // ---- read until the blank line that ends the header block ----
Lc_read_hdr:
        mov     x8, #HBUF_SIZE
        cmp     x21, x8
        b.hs    Lc_hdr_too_big
        mov     w0, w19
        add     x1, x20, x21
        sub     x2, x8, x21
        bl      _read
        cmp     x0, #0
        b.gt    Lc_scan
        b.eq    Lc_close
        bl      ___error
        ldr     w8, [x0]
        cmp     w8, #EINTR
        b.eq    Lc_read_hdr
        b       Lc_close
Lc_scan:
        subs    x9, x21, #3             // terminator may straddle reads
        csel    x9, xzr, x9, lo
        add     x21, x21, x0
        movz    w12, #0x0a0d
        movk    w12, #0x0a0d, lsl #16   // "\r\n\r\n"
1:      add     x10, x9, #4
        cmp     x10, x21
        b.hi    Lc_read_hdr
        ldr     w11, [x20, x9]
        cmp     w11, w12
        b.eq    2f
        add     x9, x9, #1
        b       1b
2:      add     x22, x9, #4

        // ---- request line: METHOD SP PATH SP VERSION CRLF ----
        mov     x9, #0
1:      ldrb    w10, [x20, x9]
        cmp     w10, #' '
        b.eq    2f
        cmp     w10, #'\r'
        b.eq    Lc_bad_request
        add     x9, x9, #1
        b       1b
2:      cbz     x9, Lc_bad_request
        mov     x27, x9
        mov     x0, x20
        mov     x1, x9
        bl      L_method
        mov     w25, w0
        add     x10, x27, #1            // path start
        mov     x11, x10
3:      ldrb    w12, [x20, x11]
        cmp     w12, #' '
        b.eq    4f
        cmp     w12, #'\r'
        b.eq    Lc_bad_request
        add     x11, x11, #1
        b       3b
4:      subs    x27, x11, x10
        b.eq    Lc_bad_request
        add     x26, x20, x10
5:      ldrb    w12, [x20, x11]         // skip to the first header line
        cmp     w12, #'\n'
        add     x11, x11, #1
        b.ne    5b

        // ---- header lines: only Content-Length matters ----
        mov     x24, #0
        sub     x13, x22, #2            // the final CRLF
Lc_hdr_line:
        cmp     x11, x13
        b.hs    Lc_hdrs_done
        mov     x12, x11
6:      ldrb    w14, [x20, x12]
        cmp     w14, #'\r'
        b.eq    7f
        add     x12, x12, #1
        b       6b
7:      sub     x14, x12, x11           // line = [x11, x12)
        cmp     x14, #15
        b.lo    Lc_next_line
        LOADADDR x15, L_cl_name
        add     x16, x20, x11
        mov     x17, #0
8:      ldrb    w0, [x16, x17]
        sub     w1, w0, #'A'
        cmp     w1, #26
        b.hs    9f
        orr     w0, w0, #0x20           // ASCII lower-case
9:      ldrb    w1, [x15, x17]
        cmp     w0, w1
        b.ne    Lc_next_line
        add     x17, x17, #1
        cmp     x17, #15
        b.lo    8b

        add     x16, x16, #15           // value
        add     x17, x20, x12           // end of line
10:     cmp     x16, x17                // leading whitespace
        b.hs    Lc_bad_request
        ldrb    w0, [x16]
        cmp     w0, #' '
        b.eq    11f
        cmp     w0, #'\t'
        b.ne    12f
11:     add     x16, x16, #1
        b       10b
12:     mov     x24, #0
        mov     x1, #0                  // digit count
        mov     x2, #10
        mov     x3, #MAX_BODY
13:     cmp     x16, x17
        b.hs    15f
        ldrb    w0, [x16]
        sub     w0, w0, #'0'
        cmp     w0, #9
        b.hi    14f
        madd    x24, x24, x2, x0
        cmp     x24, x3
        b.hi    Lc_too_large
        add     x1, x1, #1
        add     x16, x16, #1
        b       13b
14:     ldrb    w0, [x16]               // trailing whitespace only
        cmp     w0, #' '
        b.eq    16f
        cmp     w0, #'\t'
        b.ne    Lc_bad_request
16:     add     x16, x16, #1
        cmp     x16, x17
        b.lo    14b
15:     cbz     x1, Lc_bad_request
Lc_next_line:
        add     x11, x12, #2
        b       Lc_hdr_line

        // ---- body: exactly Content-Length bytes ----
Lc_hdrs_done:
        cmp     x24, #0
        csinc   x0, x24, xzr, ne        // malloc(max(cl, 1))
        bl      _malloc
        cbz     x0, Lc_server_error
        mov     x23, x0
        sub     x2, x21, x22            // body bytes already buffered
        cmp     x2, x24
        csel    x2, x2, x24, lo
        mov     x21, x2
        add     x1, x20, x22
        bl      _memcpy
Lc_read_body:
        cmp     x21, x24
        b.hs    Lc_route
        mov     w0, w19
        add     x1, x23, x21
        sub     x2, x24, x21
        bl      _read
        cmp     x0, #0
        b.gt    1f
        b.eq    Lc_close
        bl      ___error
        ldr     w8, [x0]
        cmp     w8, #EINTR
        b.eq    Lc_read_body
        b       Lc_close
1:      add     x21, x21, x0
        b       Lc_read_body

        // ---- routing ----
Lc_route:
        mov     x0, x26
        mov     x1, x27
        LOADADDR x2, L_p_health
        mov     x3, #L_p_health_len
        bl      L_memeq
        cbnz    w0, Lc_health
        mov     x0, x26
        mov     x1, x27
        LOADADDR x2, L_p_kv
        mov     x3, #KV_PATH_LEN
        bl      L_memeq
        cbnz    w0, Lc_list
        cmp     x27, #KV_PREFIX_LEN
        b.lo    Lc_not_found
        mov     x0, x26
        mov     x1, #KV_PREFIX_LEN     // "/kv/"
        LOADADDR x2, L_p_kv
        mov     x3, #KV_PREFIX_LEN
        bl      L_memeq
        cbz     w0, Lc_not_found
        add     x26, x26, #KV_PREFIX_LEN
        sub     x27, x27, #KV_PREFIX_LEN
        mov     x0, x26
        mov     x1, x27
        bl      L_valid_key
        cbz     w0, Lc_invalid_key
        cmp     w25, #M_GET
        b.eq    Lc_get
        cmp     w25, #M_PUT
        b.eq    Lc_put
        cmp     w25, #M_DELETE
        b.eq    Lc_delete
        b       Lc_method_not_allowed

Lc_health:
        cmp     w25, #M_GET
        b.ne    Lc_method_not_allowed
        mov     w1, #ST_200
        LOADADDR x2, L_ok
        mov     x3, #2
        mov     w4, #0
        b       Lc_respond

Lc_list:
        cmp     w25, #M_GET
        b.ne    Lc_method_not_allowed
        add     x0, sp, #96
        add     x1, sp, #104
        bl      _store_list
        cbnz    x0, Lc_internal_error
        mov     w4, #1
        b       Lc_respond_owned

Lc_get:
        mov     x0, x26
        mov     x1, x27
        add     x2, sp, #96
        add     x3, sp, #104
        bl      _store_get
        cmp     x0, #0
        b.eq    Lc_not_found
        b.lt    Lc_internal_error
        mov     w4, #0
Lc_respond_owned:                       // 200 with malloc'd body at [sp,#96]
        mov     w0, w19
        mov     w1, #ST_200
        ldp     x2, x3, [sp, #96]
        bl      L_respond
        ldr     x0, [sp, #96]
        bl      _free
        b       Lc_close

Lc_put:
        mov     x0, x26
        mov     x1, x27
        mov     x2, x23
        mov     x3, x24
        bl      _store_put
        cmp     x0, #0
        b.lt    Lc_internal_error
        mov     x23, #0                 // the store owns the body now
        mov     w1, #ST_200
        mov     w2, #ST_201
        csel    w1, w2, w1, gt
        b       Lc_respond_empty

Lc_delete:
        mov     x0, x26
        mov     x1, x27
        bl      _store_delete
        cbz     x0, Lc_not_found
        mov     w1, #ST_204
        b       Lc_respond_empty

Lc_not_found:
        mov     w1, #ST_404
        b       Lc_respond_empty
Lc_invalid_key:
        mov     w1, #ST_400
        b       Lc_respond_empty
Lc_method_not_allowed:
        mov     w1, #ST_405
        b       Lc_respond_empty
Lc_internal_error:
        mov     w1, #ST_500
        b       Lc_respond_empty

        // Errors detected before the body was consumed: drain afterwards so
        // the client sees the response instead of a connection reset.
Lc_bad_request:
        mov     w1, #ST_400
        b       Lc_respond_early
Lc_too_large:
        mov     w1, #ST_413
        b       Lc_respond_early
Lc_hdr_too_big:
        mov     w1, #ST_431
        b       Lc_respond_early
Lc_server_error:
        mov     w1, #ST_500
Lc_respond_early:
        mov     x28, #1
Lc_respond_empty:
        mov     x2, #0
        mov     x3, #0
        mov     w4, #0
Lc_respond:
        mov     w0, w19
        bl      L_respond

Lc_close:
        cbz     x28, 2f
        cbz     x20, 2f
        mov     w0, w19
        mov     w1, #SHUT_WR
        bl      _shutdown
        mov     x21, #0
1:      mov     w0, w19
        mov     x1, x20
        mov     x2, #HBUF_SIZE
        bl      _read
        cmp     x0, #0
        b.le    2f
        add     x21, x21, x0
        mov     x8, #DRAIN_MAX
        cmp     x21, x8
        b.lo    1b
2:      mov     x0, x23
        bl      _free
        mov     x0, x20
        bl      _free
        mov     w0, w19
        bl      _close
        mov     x0, #0
        ldp     x27, x28, [sp, #80]
        ldp     x25, x26, [sp, #64]
        ldp     x23, x24, [sp, #48]
        ldp     x21, x22, [sp, #32]
        ldp     x19, x20, [sp, #16]
        ldp     x29, x30, [sp], #112
        ret

// Send a complete response.
// In: w0 fd, w1 status index, x2 body, x3 body length, w4 nonzero => JSON.
        .p2align 2
L_respond:
        stp     x29, x30, [sp, #-48]!
        mov     x29, sp
        stp     x19, x20, [sp, #16]
        stp     x21, x22, [sp, #32]
        sub     sp, sp, #RESP_BUF
        mov     w19, w0
        mov     x20, x2
        mov     x21, x3
        mov     w22, w4
        LOADADDR x8, L_status_tab
        add     x8, x8, w1, uxtw #4
        ldp     x9, x10, [x8]           // status text, length

        mov     x0, sp
        LOADADDR x1, L_h_proto
        mov     x2, #L_h_proto_len
        bl      L_copy
        mov     x1, x9
        mov     x2, x10
        bl      L_copy
        LOADADDR x1, L_h_clen
        mov     x2, #L_h_clen_len
        bl      L_copy
        mov     x1, x21
        bl      L_utoa
        cbz     w22, 1f
        LOADADDR x1, L_h_json
        mov     x2, #L_h_json_len
        bl      L_copy
1:      LOADADDR x1, L_h_end
        mov     x2, #L_h_end_len
        bl      L_copy

        cmp     x21, #INLINE_MAX
        b.hi    2f
        mov     x1, x20                 // small body: one write
        mov     x2, x21
        bl      L_copy
        mov     x1, sp
        sub     x2, x0, x1
        mov     w0, w19
        bl      L_write_all
        b       3f
2:      mov     x1, sp
        sub     x2, x0, x1
        mov     w0, w19
        bl      L_write_all
        cbnz    x0, 3f
        mov     w0, w19
        mov     x1, x20
        mov     x2, x21
        bl      L_write_all
3:      add     sp, sp, #RESP_BUF
        ldp     x21, x22, [sp, #32]
        ldp     x19, x20, [sp, #16]
        ldp     x29, x30, [sp], #48
        ret

// Write the whole buffer. In: w0 fd, x1 buf, x2 len. Out: x0 0 ok, -1 error.
        .p2align 2
L_write_all:
        stp     x29, x30, [sp, #-48]!
        mov     x29, sp
        stp     x19, x20, [sp, #16]
        str     x21, [sp, #32]
        mov     w19, w0
        mov     x20, x1
        mov     x21, x2
1:      cbz     x21, 3f
        mov     w0, w19
        mov     x1, x20
        mov     x2, x21
        bl      _write
        cmp     x0, #0
        b.le    2f
        add     x20, x20, x0
        sub     x21, x21, x0
        b       1b
2:      b.eq    4f
        bl      ___error
        ldr     w8, [x0]
        cmp     w8, #EINTR
        b.eq    1b
4:      mov     x0, #-1
        b       5f
3:      mov     x0, #0
5:      ldr     x21, [sp, #32]
        ldp     x19, x20, [sp, #16]
        ldp     x29, x30, [sp], #48
        ret

// Leaf. Copy x2 bytes from x1 to x0; returns x0 advanced past the copy.
// Clobbers x0-x3 only.
        .p2align 2
L_copy:
        cbz     x2, 2f
1:      ldrb    w3, [x1], #1
        strb    w3, [x0], #1
        subs    x2, x2, #1
        b.ne    1b
2:      ret

// Leaf. Write x1 in decimal at x0; returns x0 advanced. Clobbers x0-x6.
        .p2align 2
L_utoa:
        mov     x5, #10
        mov     x2, x1
        mov     x3, #0
1:      udiv    x2, x2, x5              // count digits
        add     x3, x3, #1
        cbnz    x2, 1b
        add     x4, x0, x3
        mov     x0, x4
2:      udiv    x2, x1, x5
        msub    x6, x2, x5, x1
        add     w6, w6, #'0'
        strb    w6, [x4, #-1]!
        mov     x1, x2
        cbnz    x1, 2b
        ret

// Leaf. w0 = (x1 == x3 && memcmp(x0, x2, x1) == 0).
        .p2align 2
L_memeq:
        cmp     x1, x3
        b.ne    3f
        cbz     x1, 2f
1:      ldrb    w4, [x0], #1
        ldrb    w5, [x2], #1
        cmp     w4, w5
        b.ne    3f
        subs    x1, x1, #1
        b.ne    1b
2:      mov     w0, #1
        ret
3:      mov     w0, #0
        ret

// Leaf. w0 = key (x0, x1) matches [A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}.
        .p2align 2
L_valid_key:
        sub     x2, x1, #1
        cmp     x2, #64                 // unsigned: rejects 0 and > 64
        b.hs    3f
1:      ldrb    w2, [x0], #1
        sub     w3, w2, #'0'
        cmp     w3, #10
        b.lo    2f
        orr     w3, w2, #0x20           // fold case
        sub     w3, w3, #'a'
        cmp     w3, #26
        b.lo    2f
        cmp     w2, #'_'
        b.eq    2f
        cmp     w2, #'-'
        b.ne    3f
2:      subs    x1, x1, #1
        b.ne    1b
        mov     w0, #1
        ret
3:      mov     w0, #0
        ret

// Leaf. Map method token (x0, x1) to an M_* code.
        .p2align 2
L_method:
        cmp     x1, #3
        b.eq    1f
        cmp     x1, #6
        b.eq    2f
        b       9f
1:      ldrh    w2, [x0]
        ldrb    w3, [x0, #2]
        orr     w2, w2, w3, lsl #16
        movz    w4, #0x4547             // "GET"
        movk    w4, #0x54, lsl #16
        cmp     w2, w4
        b.eq    3f
        movz    w4, #0x5550             // "PUT"
        movk    w4, #0x54, lsl #16
        cmp     w2, w4
        b.eq    4f
        b       9f
2:      ldr     w2, [x0]
        ldrh    w3, [x0, #4]
        movz    w4, #0x4544             // "DELE"
        movk    w4, #0x454c, lsl #16
        cmp     w2, w4
        b.ne    9f
        mov     w4, #0x4554             // "TE"
        cmp     w3, w4
        b.ne    9f
        mov     w0, #M_DELETE
        ret
3:      mov     w0, #M_GET
        ret
4:      mov     w0, #M_PUT
        ret
9:      mov     w0, #M_OTHER
        ret

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

        .section __TEXT,__const
        .p2align 3
L_io_timeout:                           // struct timeval { 30 s }
        .quad   30
        .long   0, 0

L_cl_name:      .ascii "content-length:"
L_p_health:     .ascii "/health"
        .equ    L_p_health_len, . - L_p_health
L_p_kv:         .ascii "/kv/"                   // "/kv" route and "/kv/" key prefix
L_ok:           .ascii "ok"
L_h_proto:      .ascii "HTTP/1.1 "
        .equ    L_h_proto_len, . - L_h_proto
L_h_clen:       .ascii "\r\nContent-Length: "
        .equ    L_h_clen_len, . - L_h_clen
L_h_json:       .ascii "\r\nContent-Type: application/json"
        .equ    L_h_json_len, . - L_h_json
L_h_end:        .ascii "\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n"
        .equ    L_h_end_len, . - L_h_end

L_s200: .ascii "200 OK"
L_s201: .ascii "201 Created"
L_s204: .ascii "204 No Content"
L_s400: .ascii "400 Bad Request"
L_s404: .ascii "404 Not Found"
L_s405: .ascii "405 Method Not Allowed"
L_s413: .ascii "413 Content Too Large"
L_s431: .ascii "431 Request Header Fields Too Large"
L_s500: .ascii "500 Internal Server Error"
L_s_end:

        .section __DATA,__const
        .p2align 3
L_status_tab:                           // { const char *text; size_t len; }
        .quad   L_s200, L_s201 - L_s200
        .quad   L_s201, L_s204 - L_s201
        .quad   L_s204, L_s400 - L_s204
        .quad   L_s400, L_s404 - L_s400
        .quad   L_s404, L_s405 - L_s404
        .quad   L_s405, L_s413 - L_s405
        .quad   L_s413, L_s431 - L_s413
        .quad   L_s431, L_s500 - L_s431
        .quad   L_s500, L_s_end - L_s500

// main.s — kvhttp entry point: `app <port>` serves on 127.0.0.1:<port>.
//
// The main thread accepts connections and hands each socket to a
// detached worker thread running conn_main (see http.s).

        .equ    AF_INET, 2
        .equ    SOCK_STREAM, 1
        .equ    SOL_SOCKET, 0xffff
        .equ    SO_REUSEADDR, 4
        .equ    SIGPIPE, 13
        .equ    SIG_IGN, 1
        .equ    PTHREAD_CREATE_DETACHED, 2
        .equ    LISTEN_BACKLOG, 1024
        .equ    EINTR, 4
        .equ    ACCEPT_BACKOFF_US, 1000

.macro  LOADADDR reg, sym
        adrp    \reg, \sym@PAGE
        add     \reg, \reg, \sym@PAGEOFF
.endm

        .zerofill __DATA,__bss,L_thread_attr,64,3

        .section __TEXT,__text,regular,pure_instructions

// Frame: [sp,#48] scratch (endptr / int option), [sp,#56] pthread_t,
//        [sp,#64] struct sockaddr_in (16 bytes)
        .globl  _main
        .p2align 2
_main:
        stp     x29, x30, [sp, #-80]!
        mov     x29, sp
        stp     x19, x20, [sp, #16]
        stp     x21, x22, [sp, #32]

        cmp     w0, #2
        b.ne    Lusage
        ldr     x0, [x1, #8]
        ldrb    w8, [x0]
        cbz     w8, Lusage
        add     x1, sp, #48
        mov     w2, #10
        bl      _strtol
        ldr     x8, [sp, #48]
        ldrb    w8, [x8]
        cbnz    w8, Lusage              // trailing garbage
        cmp     x0, #1
        b.lt    Lusage
        mov     x8, #65535
        cmp     x0, x8
        b.gt    Lusage
        mov     x19, x0                 // port

        mov     w0, #SIGPIPE
        mov     x1, #SIG_IGN
        bl      _signal
        bl      _store_init

        mov     w0, #AF_INET
        mov     w1, #SOCK_STREAM
        mov     w2, #0
        bl      _socket
        LOADADDR x22, L_e_socket
        cmp     w0, #0
        b.lt    Lfatal
        mov     w20, w0

        mov     w8, #1
        str     w8, [sp, #48]
        mov     w0, w20
        mov     w1, #SOL_SOCKET
        mov     w2, #SO_REUSEADDR
        add     x3, sp, #48
        mov     w4, #4
        bl      _setsockopt

        // sockaddr_in { len 16, AF_INET, htons(port), 127.0.0.1, zero[8] }
        rev16   w9, w19
        mov     w10, #(AF_INET << 8) | 16
        orr     w10, w10, w9, lsl #16
        str     w10, [sp, #64]
        movz    w11, #0x007f
        movk    w11, #0x0100, lsl #16
        str     w11, [sp, #68]
        str     xzr, [sp, #72]
        mov     w0, w20
        add     x1, sp, #64
        mov     w2, #16
        bl      _bind
        LOADADDR x22, L_e_bind
        cmp     w0, #0
        b.lt    Lfatal
        mov     w0, w20
        mov     w1, #LISTEN_BACKLOG
        bl      _listen
        LOADADDR x22, L_e_listen
        cmp     w0, #0
        b.lt    Lfatal

        LOADADDR x21, L_thread_attr
        mov     x0, x21
        bl      _pthread_attr_init
        mov     x0, x21
        mov     w1, #PTHREAD_CREATE_DETACHED
        bl      _pthread_attr_setdetachstate

Laccept:
        mov     w0, w20
        mov     x1, #0
        mov     x2, #0
        bl      _accept
        cmp     w0, #0
        b.lt    Laccept_err
        mov     w22, w0
        add     x0, sp, #56
        mov     x1, x21
        LOADADDR x2, _conn_main
        mov     w3, w22                 // fd passed as the thread argument
        bl      _pthread_create
        cbz     w0, Laccept
        mov     w0, w22                 // no thread: drop the connection
        bl      _close
        b       Laccept
Laccept_err:
        bl      ___error
        ldr     w8, [x0]
        cmp     w8, #EINTR
        b.eq    Laccept
        mov     w0, #ACCEPT_BACKOFF_US  // e.g. EMFILE: back off briefly
        bl      _usleep
        b       Laccept

Lusage:
        LOADADDR x22, L_usage
        mov     x0, x22
        bl      _strlen
        mov     x2, x0
        mov     w0, #2
        mov     x1, x22
        bl      _write
        mov     w0, #2
        bl      _exit

Lfatal:                                 // x22 = name of the failed call
        mov     x0, x22
        bl      _perror
        mov     w0, #1
        bl      _exit

        .section __TEXT,__cstring,cstring_literals
L_usage:    .asciz "usage: app <port>\n"
L_e_socket: .asciz "socket"
L_e_bind:   .asciz "bind"
L_e_listen: .asciz "listen"

// store.s — thread-safe in-memory key/value store for kvhttp.
//
// Entries are kept in a pointer array sorted by key (bytewise, then by
// length), which gives O(log n) lookup and makes the sorted key listing
// for `GET /kv` a linear walk. A single mutex guards the whole store.
//
// Public API (all functions take/return per AAPCS64):
//   store_init()                                   -> void
//   store_put(key, klen, val, vlen)                -> 1 new, 0 replaced, -1 OOM
//        On success the store takes ownership of `val` (malloc'd).
//   store_get(key, klen, out_ptr*, out_len*)       -> 1 found, 0 absent, -1 OOM
//        On success *out_ptr is a malloc'd copy the caller must free.
//   store_delete(key, klen)                        -> 1 deleted, 0 absent
//   store_list(out_ptr*, out_len*)                 -> 0 ok, -1 OOM
//        Produces a JSON array of all keys; caller frees *out_ptr.

        // Entry record (malloc'd, one per key)
        .equ    E_KLEN, 0
        .equ    E_VAL, 8
        .equ    E_VLEN, 16
        .equ    E_KEY, 24
        .equ    E_SIZE, 88              // 24 + 64-byte key

        // Store state record
        .equ    S_LOCK, 0               // pthread_mutex_t (64 bytes)
        .equ    S_ENTRIES, 64           // Entry** sorted array
        .equ    S_COUNT, 72
        .equ    S_CAP, 80
        .equ    S_SIZE, 88

        .equ    INITIAL_CAP, 64

        .zerofill __DATA,__bss,L_store,S_SIZE,4

// Load the address of the store state into \reg.
.macro  STORE_ADDR reg
        adrp    \reg, L_store@PAGE
        add     \reg, \reg, L_store@PAGEOFF
.endm

        .section __TEXT,__text,regular,pure_instructions

// void store_init(void)
        .globl  _store_init
        .p2align 2
_store_init:
        STORE_ADDR x0
        mov     x1, #0
        b       _pthread_mutex_init

// Leaf. Compare key (x0, x1) with Entry* x2.
// Returns x0 <0, 0, >0. Clobbers x0-x7 only.
        .p2align 2
L_keycmp:
        ldr     x3, [x2, #E_KLEN]
        add     x2, x2, #E_KEY
        cmp     x1, x3
        csel    x4, x1, x3, lo          // common prefix length
        mov     x5, #0
1:      cmp     x5, x4
        b.hs    2f
        ldrb    w6, [x0, x5]
        ldrb    w7, [x2, x5]
        add     x5, x5, #1
        cmp     w6, w7
        b.eq    1b
        sub     x0, x6, x7
        ret
2:      sub     x0, x1, x3
        ret

// Binary search; caller holds the lock.
// In: x0 key, x1 klen. Out: x0 index (match or insertion point), x1 found.
        .p2align 2
L_find:
        stp     x29, x30, [sp, #-64]!
        mov     x29, sp
        stp     x19, x20, [sp, #16]
        stp     x21, x22, [sp, #32]
        stp     x23, x24, [sp, #48]
        mov     x19, x0
        mov     x20, x1
        STORE_ADDR x8
        mov     x21, #0                 // lo
        ldr     x22, [x8, #S_COUNT]     // hi
        ldr     x23, [x8, #S_ENTRIES]
1:      cmp     x21, x22
        b.hs    3f
        add     x24, x21, x22
        lsr     x24, x24, #1            // mid
        ldr     x2, [x23, x24, lsl #3]
        mov     x0, x19
        mov     x1, x20
        bl      L_keycmp
        cmp     x0, #0
        b.eq    2f
        b.lt    4f
        add     x21, x24, #1
        b       1b
4:      mov     x22, x24
        b       1b
2:      mov     x0, x24
        mov     x1, #1
        b       5f
3:      mov     x0, x21
        mov     x1, #0
5:      ldp     x23, x24, [sp, #48]
        ldp     x21, x22, [sp, #32]
        ldp     x19, x20, [sp, #16]
        ldp     x29, x30, [sp], #64
        ret

// long store_put(const char *key, size_t klen, void *val, size_t vlen)
        .globl  _store_put
        .p2align 2
_store_put:
        stp     x29, x30, [sp, #-80]!
        mov     x29, sp
        stp     x19, x20, [sp, #16]
        stp     x21, x22, [sp, #32]
        stp     x23, x24, [sp, #48]
        stp     x25, x26, [sp, #64]
        mov     x19, x0                 // key
        mov     x20, x1                 // klen
        mov     x21, x2                 // val
        mov     x22, x3                 // vlen
        STORE_ADDR x25
        mov     x0, x25
        bl      _pthread_mutex_lock
        mov     x0, x19
        mov     x1, x20
        bl      L_find
        mov     x23, x0                 // index
        cbz     x1, Lput_new

        // Replace the value of an existing entry.
        ldr     x8, [x25, #S_ENTRIES]
        ldr     x9, [x8, x23, lsl #3]
        ldr     x24, [x9, #E_VAL]       // old value, freed outside the lock
        str     x21, [x9, #E_VAL]
        str     x22, [x9, #E_VLEN]
        mov     x0, x25
        bl      _pthread_mutex_unlock
        mov     x0, x24
        bl      _free
        mov     x0, #0
        b       Lput_ret

Lput_new:
        ldr     x9, [x25, #S_COUNT]
        ldr     x10, [x25, #S_CAP]
        cmp     x9, x10
        b.lo    Lput_have_cap
        lsl     x26, x10, #1
        mov     x11, #INITIAL_CAP
        cmp     x10, #0
        csel    x26, x11, x26, eq       // new capacity
        ldr     x0, [x25, #S_ENTRIES]
        lsl     x1, x26, #3
        bl      _realloc
        cbz     x0, Lput_oom
        str     x0, [x25, #S_ENTRIES]
        str     x26, [x25, #S_CAP]
Lput_have_cap:
        mov     x0, #E_SIZE
        bl      _malloc
        cbz     x0, Lput_oom
        mov     x24, x0
        str     x20, [x24, #E_KLEN]
        str     x21, [x24, #E_VAL]
        str     x22, [x24, #E_VLEN]
        add     x0, x24, #E_KEY
        mov     x1, x19
        mov     x2, x20
        bl      _memcpy
        // Open a slot at `index`.
        ldr     x8, [x25, #S_ENTRIES]
        ldr     x9, [x25, #S_COUNT]
        add     x1, x8, x23, lsl #3
        add     x0, x1, #8
        sub     x2, x9, x23
        lsl     x2, x2, #3
        bl      _memmove
        ldr     x8, [x25, #S_ENTRIES]
        str     x24, [x8, x23, lsl #3]
        ldr     x9, [x25, #S_COUNT]
        add     x9, x9, #1
        str     x9, [x25, #S_COUNT]
        mov     x0, x25
        bl      _pthread_mutex_unlock
        mov     x0, #1
        b       Lput_ret

Lput_oom:
        mov     x0, x25
        bl      _pthread_mutex_unlock
        mov     x0, #-1
Lput_ret:
        ldp     x25, x26, [sp, #64]
        ldp     x23, x24, [sp, #48]
        ldp     x21, x22, [sp, #32]
        ldp     x19, x20, [sp, #16]
        ldp     x29, x30, [sp], #80
        ret

// long store_get(const char *key, size_t klen, void **out, size_t *outlen)
        .globl  _store_get
        .p2align 2
_store_get:
        stp     x29, x30, [sp, #-64]!
        mov     x29, sp
        stp     x19, x20, [sp, #16]
        stp     x21, x22, [sp, #32]
        stp     x23, x24, [sp, #48]
        mov     x19, x0
        mov     x20, x1
        mov     x21, x2
        mov     x22, x3
        STORE_ADDR x23
        mov     x0, x23
        bl      _pthread_mutex_lock
        mov     x0, x19
        mov     x1, x20
        bl      L_find
        cbz     x1, Lget_absent
        ldr     x8, [x23, #S_ENTRIES]
        ldr     x24, [x8, x0, lsl #3]   // entry
        ldr     x0, [x24, #E_VLEN]
        cmp     x0, #0
        csinc   x0, x0, xzr, ne         // malloc(max(vlen, 1))
        bl      _malloc
        cbz     x0, Lget_oom
        mov     x19, x0
        ldr     x1, [x24, #E_VAL]
        ldr     x2, [x24, #E_VLEN]
        bl      _memcpy
        str     x19, [x21]
        ldr     x9, [x24, #E_VLEN]
        str     x9, [x22]
        mov     x19, #1
        b       Lget_unlock
Lget_absent:
        mov     x19, #0
        b       Lget_unlock
Lget_oom:
        mov     x19, #-1
Lget_unlock:
        mov     x0, x23
        bl      _pthread_mutex_unlock
        mov     x0, x19
        ldp     x23, x24, [sp, #48]
        ldp     x21, x22, [sp, #32]
        ldp     x19, x20, [sp, #16]
        ldp     x29, x30, [sp], #64
        ret

// long store_delete(const char *key, size_t klen)
        .globl  _store_delete
        .p2align 2
_store_delete:
        stp     x29, x30, [sp, #-48]!
        mov     x29, sp
        stp     x19, x20, [sp, #16]
        stp     x21, x22, [sp, #32]
        mov     x19, x0
        mov     x20, x1
        STORE_ADDR x21
        mov     x0, x21
        bl      _pthread_mutex_lock
        mov     x0, x19
        mov     x1, x20
        bl      L_find
        cbz     x1, Ldel_absent
        ldr     x8, [x21, #S_ENTRIES]
        ldr     x22, [x8, x0, lsl #3]   // entry being removed
        ldr     x9, [x21, #S_COUNT]
        sub     x9, x9, #1
        str     x9, [x21, #S_COUNT]
        // Close the gap: memmove(&a[i], &a[i+1], (count-1-i)*8)
        sub     x2, x9, x0
        lsl     x2, x2, #3
        add     x0, x8, x0, lsl #3
        add     x1, x0, #8
        bl      _memmove
        mov     x0, x21
        bl      _pthread_mutex_unlock
        ldr     x0, [x22, #E_VAL]
        bl      _free
        mov     x0, x22
        bl      _free
        mov     x0, #1
        b       Ldel_ret
Ldel_absent:
        mov     x0, x21
        bl      _pthread_mutex_unlock
        mov     x0, #0
Ldel_ret:
        ldp     x21, x22, [sp, #32]
        ldp     x19, x20, [sp, #16]
        ldp     x29, x30, [sp], #48
        ret

// long store_list(char **out, size_t *outlen)
        .globl  _store_list
        .p2align 2
_store_list:
        stp     x29, x30, [sp, #-64]!
        mov     x29, sp
        stp     x19, x20, [sp, #16]
        stp     x21, x22, [sp, #32]
        stp     x23, x24, [sp, #48]
        mov     x19, x0
        mov     x20, x1
        STORE_ADDR x21
        mov     x0, x21
        bl      _pthread_mutex_lock
        ldr     x22, [x21, #S_COUNT]
        ldr     x23, [x21, #S_ENTRIES]
        // Size: "[" + "]" + per key: quotes, comma, key bytes.
        mov     x0, #2
        mov     x9, #0
1:      cmp     x9, x22
        b.hs    2f
        ldr     x10, [x23, x9, lsl #3]
        ldr     x10, [x10, #E_KLEN]
        add     x0, x0, x10
        add     x0, x0, #3
        add     x9, x9, #1
        b       1b
2:      bl      _malloc
        cbz     x0, Llist_oom
        mov     x24, x0
        mov     x0, x24                 // write cursor
        mov     w11, #'['
        strb    w11, [x0], #1
        mov     x9, #0
3:      cmp     x9, x22
        b.hs    6f
        cbz     x9, 4f
        mov     w11, #','
        strb    w11, [x0], #1
4:      mov     w11, #'"'
        strb    w11, [x0], #1
        ldr     x10, [x23, x9, lsl #3]
        ldr     x12, [x10, #E_KLEN]
        add     x10, x10, #E_KEY
5:      ldrb    w13, [x10], #1
        strb    w13, [x0], #1
        subs    x12, x12, #1
        b.ne    5b
        strb    w11, [x0], #1
        add     x9, x9, #1
        b       3b
6:      mov     w11, #']'
        strb    w11, [x0], #1
        sub     x0, x0, x24
        str     x24, [x19]
        str     x0, [x20]
        mov     x22, #0
        b       Llist_unlock
Llist_oom:
        mov     x22, #-1
Llist_unlock:
        mov     x0, x21
        bl      _pthread_mutex_unlock
        mov     x0, x22
        ldp     x23, x24, [sp, #48]
        ldp     x21, x22, [sp, #32]
        ldp     x19, x20, [sp, #16]
        ldp     x29, x30, [sp], #64
        ret
